note: Set A's eight claims all misread the chart: the percentages (15%, 25%, 54%, etc.) are span-position labels on the x-axis, not shear layup layer thickness values, which are plotted in mm on the y-axis and stacked by material (CarbonUD, Gelcoat, glass_biax, etc.). The entities (FFA-W3-xxx, SNL-FFA-W3-500) are span/section labels rather than components, so every claim binds the wrong property and unit to the quoted text. Set B extracts nothing and so misses the real thickness data, but it introduces no misread claims. Given that all of A's claims are misbound while B has none wrong, B is the safer set.
